Build-a-Bear 2026 Holiday Sanrio Plush Are Pochacco, Kuromi, and Hello Kitty
Frosted versions of Hello Kitty, Kuromi, and Pochacco are part of the Build-a-Bear Sanrio 2026 holiday and Christmas plush collection.

English The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Voice Actors Revealed
Thanks to the game's release, we now know The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake's English voice actors.

Myethos' new Honkai: Star Rail figures include a Gift+ scale one of Dan Heng and a new Dorm Series line of chibi folks in pajamas.

The Stellar Blade Bayonetta crossover costumes are on every platform and there are patch notes for the outfits and other updates.

There are new sales milestones for the Switch 2 console and 2026 games like Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave and Pokemon Pokopia.

Sega’s Hatsune Miku x Cinnamoroll Luminasta Figure Returns
It took three years, but Sega will bring back the Hatsune Miku x Cinnamoroll Luminasta figure again.

text:

Stellar Blade Complete Edition feels quite at home on the Switch 2 and still can feel like a must-play sort of action game.

The new mobile versions will not have cross-play with the console releases because they also have more differences.

The Honkai: Nexus Anima Final Closed Beta test date is set for this month and the release window is set for the first half of 2027.

The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom Link, Zelda, and Korok plush dolls and Link FIGURIZMa figure are back after two years.

Applin, Appleton, Dipplin, Flapple, and Hydrapple star in the November 2026 Pokemon Pokopia event.
